WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE pending_review SET status = 'approved' WHERE video_id = $1 AND status = 'pending' RETURNING video_id, channel_name, video_url, file_name, file_content, part, chapter
)
SELECT $1::text AS video_id, $2::text AS callback_query_id, $3::bigint AS message_id, $4::bigint AS chat_id, $5::text AS update_id,
       (SELECT channel_name FROM upd) AS channel_name,
       (SELECT video_url FROM upd) AS video_url,
       (SELECT file_name FROM upd) AS file_name,
       (SELECT file_content FROM upd) AS file_content,
       (SELECT part FROM upd) AS part,
       (SELECT chapter FROM upd) AS chapter,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS updated;
UPDATE video_files SET status = 'rejected', is_processed = true WHERE video_id = $1 RETURNING video_id;

UPDATE video_files SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = true THEN 'done' ELSE 'error' END, is_processed = true, attempts = COALESCE(attempts, 0) + CASE WHEN $2 = true THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, last_error = CASE WHEN $2 = true THEN NULL ELSE $3 END WHERE video_id = $1 RETURNING video_id, status;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS video_id,
    $2::text AS video_url,
    $3::text AS file_name,
    $4::text AS channel_name,
    $5::text AS error_message
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO video_errors (video_id, video_url, title, channel_name, channel_topic, error_message, status, level, category, source, resolved)
  SELECT video_id, video_url, file_name, channel_name, '╨╛╨▒╤Г╤З╨╡╨╜╨╕╨╡_╤В╨╛╤А╨│╨╛╨▓╨╗╨╡_╨╜╨░_╤А╤Л╨╜╨║╨░╤Е', error_message, 'error', 'ERROR', 'write', 'handler', false
  FROM input
  RETURNING video_id
)
UPDATE video_files vf
SET status = CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(vf.attempts, 0) + 1 < 3 THEN 'pending'
    ELSE 'error'
  END,
  attempts = COALESCE(vf.attempts, 0) + 1,
  is_processed = false,
  last_error = (SELECT error_message FROM input)
WHERE vf.video_id = (SELECT video_id FROM input)
RETURNING vf.video_id, vf.status;
UPDATE tg_updates SET processed = true WHERE update_id = $1 RETURNING update_id;
UPDATE tg_updates SET processed = true WHERE update_id = $1 RETURNING update_id;
UPDATE tg_updates SET processed = true WHERE update_id = $1 RETURNING update_id;
